transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in today?

Yeah, hi. Um... well, I guess people just keep saying I'm not listening to them. Like my wife, or my supervisor at work. They'll be talking straight to me, and... I don't know, a minute later I realize I only caught half of it. Then I end up having to ask them to say it again. So... yeah. That's what brought me in.
Has this trouble catching what people say been something you've noticed your whole life, or is it a new change that started more recently?

Um... not my whole life, no. I guess it's been this bad for... maybe two years? Two years and a couple months. Just... my wife started working outside the home around then. I had to start handling more of the schedule on my own. So... yeah. That's when it got worse.
How has your sleep been over these past two years—are you having any trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or feeling rested when you wake up?
Sleep? Um... no, it's fine. I fall asleep okay. Just... normal, I guess. I haven't really noticed any problems with that.
Do you notice this trouble catching what people say happening more in certain situations, like in noisy places or over the phone, or does it seem to happen no matter where you are?
Um... I don't know. It just happens. Doesn't really matter where we are, I guess. Noise or no noise, I just... miss things.
Over these past two years, have you found yourself worrying excessively about various things—like work, family, or health—more days than not?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't think I worry any more than anyone else. Just normal stuff, I guess. I haven't really noticed it being a problem.
Over these past two years, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, most of the day, nearly every day?
No. I mean... I don't feel down all the time or anything. I still like doing my regular stuff. So... no. Not really.
Have you noticed needing to turn up the volume on the TV or phone more than you used to, or experienced any ringing or muffled hearing in your ears?
Uh... no. My hearing's fine. I haven't really noticed needing to turn the volume up or anything. No ringing either. It's just normal.
Thinking back to when you were a child in school, did teachers or parents ever say you had trouble paying attention, staying focused, or finishing tasks?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, I've kind of always been like this. Even as a kid. Teachers were always moving my seat around... said I couldn't stay put. I'd, uh, call out answers a lot. Got in trouble for butting into other kids' work and stuff. That was mostly before middle school, I think. So... yeah.
